name: vibecode-security-gate-portal
description: Local web portal for public-sector vibe coding security checks.

scripts.check: node --check src/server.js && node --check scripts/portal-harness-gate.mjs && node --check scripts/portal-button-contract-test.mjs
scripts.security:scan: gvskb scan src --profile dev-quick --format json --output reports/dev-quick-src --max-files 200 --fail-on block
scripts.guard: npm run check && npm run harness:gate && npm run button:test && npm run scenario:test && npm run security:scan
